title: Bitcoin Price Slips to Lows Not Seen Since 2024, Nasdaq Plunges 5%
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Bitcoin Price Slips to Lows Not Seen Since 2024, Nasdaq Plunges 5%

The bitcoin price slipped to near $58,300 on Friday afternoon, briefly dipping under its summer low, as a chip-led selloff sent the Nasdaq down about 5% and dragged crypto stocks and miners sharply lower.

This post Bitcoin Price Slips to Lows Not Seen Since 2024, Nasdaq Plunges 5% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme

The SEC obtained an asset freeze against Backward Hat Capital and its founders, alleging a $560 million Ponzi scheme sold as AI-driven FX trading funded through crypto. Prosecutors and the CFTC filed parallel cases.

This post SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal

Blockstream researchers published a 131-page security analysis of SHRINCS, a hash-based post-quantum signature scheme for Bitcoin, and are asking the community to review it for flaws.

This post Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
